evidence.content: Hi Jamie, I'm preparing a training packet outline (modules: account setup, data handling, incident reporting; date July 8; cohort of 32; currently planned as PDF). It needs to be usable by the entire invited cohort. Given your accessibility services experience, is a PDF a good format, or would you recommend an accessible alternative or extra accessibility requirements (e.g., tagged PDF, alt text, screen reader compatibility)?
The accessibility coordinator knows that several participants use screen readers and recommends tagged headings, descriptive links, and alt text for diagrams.
